def format_long_text(text: str, color: str='', columns: int=
    get_terminal_size().columns, start_line_decorator: str=' ',
    end_line_decorator: str=' ', max_lines: Optional[int]=None, styling:
    Optional[Dict[str, Any]]=None, indent: str='', sub_indent: str='') ->str:
    if columns:
        width = columns - len(start_line_decorator) - len(end_line_decorator)
        if indent or sub_indent:
            wrapper = textwrap.TextWrapper(
                width=width,
                initial_indent=indent,
                subsequent_indent=sub_indent if sub_indent else indent
            )
        else:
            wrapper = textwrap.TextWrapper(width=width)
        
        wrapped_lines = wrapper.wrap(text)
        
        if not wrapped_lines:
            wrapped_lines = ['']
        
        if max_lines:
            wrapped_lines = wrapped_lines[:max_lines]
        
        result_lines = []
        for line in wrapped_lines:
            if color:
                line = click.style(line, fg=color)
            result_lines.append(f'{start_line_decorator}{line}{end_line_decorator}')
        
        result = '\n'.join(result_lines)
    else:
        if color:
            text = click.style(text, fg=color)
        result = f'{start_line_decorator}{text}{end_line_decorator}'
    
    return result


def get_printable_list_of_scanned_items(scanning_target: str) ->Tuple[List[
    Dict[str, Any]], List[str]]:
    ctx = SafetyContext()
    
    styled_items = []
    plain_items = []
    
    if scanning_target == 'environment':
        scanned_paths = ctx.scanned_full_path if hasattr(ctx, 'scanned_full_path') else []
        if not scanned_paths:
            msg = 'No locations found in the environment'
            styled_items.append([{'styled': False, 'value': msg}])
            plain_items.append(msg)
        else:
            for path in scanned_paths:
                styled_items.append([{'styled': False, 'value': f'-> {path}'}])
                plain_items.append(path)
    
    elif scanning_target == 'file':
        file_obj = ctx.params.get('file', None)
        if file_obj:
            styled_items.append([{'styled': False, 'value': f'-> {file_obj.name}'}])
            plain_items.append(file_obj.name)
    
    elif scanning_target == 'files':
        files = ctx.params.get('files', [])
        for f in files:
            styled_items.append([{'styled': False, 'value': f'-> {f.name}'}])
            plain_items.append(f.name)
    
    elif scanning_target == 'stdin':
        packages = ctx.packages if hasattr(ctx, 'packages') else []
        if not packages:
            msg = 'No found packages in stdin'
            styled_items.append([{'styled': False, 'value': msg}])
            plain_items.append(msg)
        else:
            for pkg in packages:
                styled_items.append([{'styled': False, 'value': pkg.name}])
                plain_items.append(pkg.name)
    
    return styled_items, plain_items

def format_long_text(text: str, color: str='', columns: int=
    get_terminal_size().columns, start_line_decorator: str=' ',
    end_line_decorator: str=' ', max_lines: Optional[int]=None, styling:
    Optional[Dict[str, Any]]=None, indent: str='', sub_indent: str='') ->str:
    if columns:
        width = columns - len(start_line_decorator) - len(end_line_decorator)
        if indent or sub_indent:
            wrapper = textwrap.TextWrapper(
                width=width,
                initial_indent=indent,
                subsequent_indent=sub_indent if sub_indent else indent
            )
        else:
            wrapper = textwrap.TextWrapper(width=width)
        
        wrapped_lines = wrapper.wrap(text)
        
        if not wrapped_lines:
            wrapped_lines = ['']
        
        if max_lines:
            wrapped_lines = wrapped_lines[:max_lines]
        
        result_lines = []
        for line in wrapped_lines:
            if color:
                line = click.style(line, fg=color)
            result_lines.append(f'{start_line_decorator}{line}{end_line_decorator}')
        
        result = '\n'.join(result_lines)
    else:
        if color:
            text = click.style(text, fg=color)
        result = f'{start_line_decorator}{text}{end_line_decorator}'
    
    return result


def get_printable_list_of_scanned_items(scanning_target: str) ->Tuple[List[
    Dict[str, Any]], List[str]]:
    ctx = SafetyContext()
    
    styled_items = []
    plain_items = []
    
    if scanning_target == 'environment':
        scanned_paths = ctx.scanned_full_path if hasattr(ctx, 'scanned_full_path') else []
        if not scanned_paths:
            msg = 'No locations found in the environment'
            styled_items.append([{'styled': False, 'value': msg}])
            plain_items.append(msg)
        else:
            for path in scanned_paths:
                styled_items.append([{'styled': False, 'value': f'-> {path}'}])
                plain_items.append(path)
    
    elif scanning_target == 'file':
        file_obj = ctx.params.get('file', None)
        if file_obj:
            styled_items.append([{'styled': False, 'value': f'-> {file_obj.name}'}])
            plain_items.append(file_obj.name)
    
    elif scanning_target == 'files':
        files = ctx.params.get('files', [])
        for f in files:
            styled_items.append([{'styled': False, 'value': f'-> {f.name}'}])
            plain_items.append(f.name)
    
    elif scanning_target == 'stdin':
        packages = ctx.packages if hasattr(ctx, 'packages') else []
        if not packages:
            msg = 'No found packages in stdin'
            styled_items.append([{'styled': False, 'value': msg}])
            plain_items.append(msg)
        else:
            for pkg in packages:
                styled_items.append([{'styled': False, 'value': pkg.name}])
                plain_items.append(pkg.name)
    
    return styled_items, plain_items

def build_report_brief_section(columns: Optional[int]=None,
    primary_announcement: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]=None, report_type: int=1,
    **kwargs: Any) ->str:
    brief_info = get_report_brief_info(as_dict=False, report_type=report_type, **kwargs)
    
    if not columns:
        columns = get_terminal_size().columns
    
    separator = '+' + '=' * (columns - 2) + '+'
    
    section = separator + '\n'
    
    if primary_announcement:
        try:
            announcement_text = build_primary_announcement(primary_announcement, columns=columns)
            section += announcement_text
            section += separator + '\n'
        except (ValueError, Exception):
            pass
    
    for line_info in brief_info:
        line_text = ''
        for item in line_info:
            value = item.get('value', '')
            style_flag = item.get('style', False)
            if style_flag:
                line_text += click.style(value, bold=True)
            else:
                line_text += value
        section += ' ' + line_text + '\n'
    
    section += separator
    
    return section


def build_using_sentence(account: Optional[str], key: Optional[str], db:
    Optional[str]) ->List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    if account:
        using_text = [
            {'style': False, 'value': 'Using Safety\'s '},
            {'style': True, 'value': 'commercial API'},
            {'style': False, 'value': ' with account '},
            {'style': True, 'value': account},
        ]
    elif key:
        using_text = [
            {'style': False, 'value': 'Using Safety\'s '},
            {'style': True, 'value': 'commercial API'},
            {'style': False, 'value': ' with key '},
            {'style': True, 'value': key[:4] + '...'},
        ]
    elif db:
        if is_a_remote_mirror(db):
            using_text = [
                {'style': False, 'value': 'Using a remote mirror: '},
                {'style': True, 'value': db},
            ]
        else:
            using_text = [
                {'style': False, 'value': 'Using a local database: '},
                {'style': True, 'value': db},
            ]
    else:
        using_text = [
            {'style': False, 'value': 'Using Safety\'s '},
            {'style': True, 'value': 'free database'},
            {'style': False, 'value': ' (updated once a month)'},
        ]
    
    return using_text


def build_scanned_count_sentence(packages: List[Package]) ->List[Dict[str, Any]
    ]:
    count = len(packages)
    return [
        {'style': False, 'value': 'Found '},
        {'style': True, 'value': str(count)},
        {'style': False, 'value': f' {"package" if count == 1 else "packages"}'},
    ]


def get_report_brief_info(as_dict: bool=False, report_type: int=1, **kwargs:
    Any):
    ctx = SafetyContext()
    
    if report_type == 2:
        return build_report_for_review_vuln_report(as_dict=as_dict)
    
    if as_dict:
        telemetry = build_telemetry_data(telemetry=kwargs.get('telemetry', True))
        git = build_git_data()
        
        result = {
            'safety_version': get_safety_version(),
            'timestamp': str(datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')),
            'scan_target': kwargs.get('scanning_target', 'environment'),
            'scanned': [],
            'api_key': bool(ctx.key),
            'packages_found': len(ctx.packages) if ctx.packages else 0,
            'telemetry': telemetry,
            'git': git,
        }
        
        _, plain_items = get_printable_list_of_scanned_items(kwargs.get('scanning_target', 'environment'))
        result['scanned'] = plain_items
        
        return result
    
    scanning_target = kwargs.get('scanning_target', 'environment')
    
    safety_policy_used = []
    policy_f_name = ctx.params.get('policy_file', None)
    if policy_f_name:
        safety_policy_used = [
            {'style': False, 'value': '\nScanning using a security policy file'},
            {'style': True, 'value': ' {0}'.format(policy_f_name)},
        ]
    
    action_executed = [
        {'style': True, 'value': 'Scanning dependencies'},
        {'style': False, 'value': ' in your '},
        {'style': True, 'value': scanning_target + ':'},
    ]
    
    scanned_items, _ = get_printable_list_of_scanned_items(scanning_target)
    
    nl = [{'style': False, 'value': ''}]
    
    using_sentence = build_using_sentence(ctx.account if hasattr(ctx, 'account') else None,
                                          ctx.key,
                                          ctx.params.get('db', None))
    scanned_count_sentence = build_scanned_count_sentence(ctx.packages if ctx.packages else [])
    
    now = str(datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'))
    timestamp = [{'style': False, 'value': 'Timestamp '}, {'style': True, 'value': now}]
    
    brief_info = [
        [{'style': False, 'value': 'Safety '},
         {'style': True, 'value': 'v' + get_safety_version()},
         {'style': False, 'value': ' is scanning for '},
         {'style': True, 'value': 'Vulnerabilities'},
         {'style': True, 'value': '...'}] + safety_policy_used,
        action_executed
    ] + [nl] + scanned_items + [nl] + [using_sentence] + [scanned_count_sentence] + [timestamp]
    
    add_warnings_if_needed(brief_info)
    
    return brief_info


def format_unpinned_vulnerabilities(unpinned_packages: Dict[str, List[Any]],
    columns: Optional[int]=None) ->List[str]:
    result = []
    
    for pkg_name, vulns in unpinned_packages.items():
        vuln_count = len(vulns)
        if vuln_count > 0:
            line = f'Warning: {vuln_count} known {"vulnerability" if vuln_count == 1 else "vulnerabilities"} match the {pkg_name} versions that could be'
            result.append(line)
    
    return result
